about_the_game:
"My Cute Plushie Tileset" is a charming collection of map chips featuring plush toys—some with doll-like elements—complete with pose and facial expression variations.
Almost every plushie comes with differences, making this set especially useful for subtle horror effects like “Wait... wasn’t that plushie facing the other way before?” moments.

□ Included Content

Tilesets: 1 sheet

  • 11 types of birds

  • 2 sloth-like creatures

  • 2 types of sheep

  • 1 type of frog (*no variation for tadpoles)

  • 6 dark-colored plushies

  • 6 small dolls

  • 16 light-colored plushies

--------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
